t: The Yale, KM Series, thumbturn euro cylinder in satin nickel provides high-performance door security for various applications. Fire rated for 30 and 60 minutes, it is ideal for upgrading security on PVCu, timber, and composite doors in both residential and commercial settings. The 6-pin cylinder is TS007 1 star kitemarked, offering robust protection against common attack methods. Features include anti-snap, anti-pick, anti-drill, and anti-bump resistance, ensuring enhanced safety. Its patented key design prevents unauthorised duplication.
